targets.authors: Saffran, J. R., Newport, E. L., & Aslin, R. N.
targets.title: Word segmentation: The role of distributional cues
targets.evidence_quote: In this paper, we describe a replication of Experiment 1 from a classic staistical word-segmentation paper by Saffran, Newport, and Aslin 1996 (henceforth: SNA96).
targets.outcome_quote: We were able to replicate SNA96’s finding of above-chance recognition of words in a statistical learning paradigm. However, we are not able to conclude that this learning would generalize to other stimuli – a question that SNA96 did not address. We were unable to confirm any of SNA96’s other observations.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Discussion confirms above-chance recognition but explicitly states that no other original observations were confirmed. Revised analyses use this replication’s new data, not the original data.
